{{Attr|Freeze}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Void Vault}}''' - Summons in eight [[Voidling]]s with a 0.15 delay between each. |ability1_cooldown = 14 }} ==Description== The '''Void Portal''' is an immobile summoner enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It does not appear naturally and instead spawned by the [[Void Trickster]]. It has decent health and cannot move. Its only purpose is to spawn eight [[Voidling]]s every 14 seconds, with a 0.15 delay between each [[Voidling]] spawn. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Portal is circular in shape, does a lot of spooky sounding things, and otherwise doesn’t like to be bothered. It simply likes to connect one place to another. That’s about it. If someone from the Void Army pesters a Void Portal enough it will intentionally send them to the outer far reaches of the eternal nothing, leaving them all alone for eternity. Void Caster knows the Void Portal does this, and out of pity will go and bring the unfortunate creature back to her army. Sometimes, she scolds the portal for it. The portal, however, doesn’t seem to care and will absolutely do it again. In fact. It already did.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Portal''' is a large purple portal in the shape of a circle. ==Strategy== *The '''Void Portal''' should be dealt with as soon as possible, otherwise it is likely you will be overwhelmed by the large hordes of [[Voidling]]s spawned. This is even more important if several '''Void Portals''' are active as they can collectively spawn a vast number of [[Voidling]]s. **Long-range towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] set to ''Last Enemy'' are highly effective at taking out '''Void Portals''' quickly, along with the [[Void Trickster]]s that create them. **You can also use the [[Gatling Gun]] to focus on '''Void Portals''' before they spawn too many [[Voidling]]s. *Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] can be used to clear out the groups of [[Voidling]]s spawned. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidPortalIconIG.png|'''Void Portal''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Portal''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Portal''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **''Void Vault'' changed. ***[[Voidling]] spawn count increased from 6 to 8. ***[[Voidling]] delay decreased from 0.35 to 0.15. ***Ability cooldown increased from 12 to 14. *'''26 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0|v2.11.2]] **Now appears in [[Nil Zone II]] as part of the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]] {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Hardcore]] [[Category:Voidcore]]
